shared_elements: animals rendered in low relief in profile
horizontal band of small repeated marks acting as a border/divider
overlapping or stacked arrangement of several creatures
justification: Both surfaces show animals carved in profile low relief, including a bird-like creature with textured wing/plumage and a predator's body, and both include a horizontal band of small repeated incised marks separating or bordering the figures. However, A is a tall vertical field divided into stacked registers with many small, flat, schematic isolated creatures (canid, bird, crouching figure, long-necked bird) shown side by side, whereas B is a single horizontal frieze dominated by one or two large, more rounded and modelled overlapping bodies engaged with each other, so the compositional scheme and figural scale conventions differ substantially.
